archetypes.name: dyn-gh-wrapper-contracts
archetypes.rationale: New issue wrappers must preserve exact argv, optional-flag omission, and read-vs-mutation retry policy.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/larch/git/gh.py issue_list_read, issue_view_read, issue_view_template_read, issue_close, issue_edit_body_file, and the optional-repo changes to issue_label_add/remove. Verify reads use _retry_read/_raise_read_failure, mutations call _gh once, plain view never adds --json/--template, list never emits --paginate, and caller-owned body-file paths are passed through unchanged. Cross-check python/tests/git/test_gh.py assertions against those contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
